semiconductor_relevance: High — Be First Technology Co., Ltd. is a significant supplier of semiconductor manufacturing and testing equipment in China.
summary: Be First Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in providing high-quality semiconductor, SMT, and LCD manufacturing equipment, along with test instruments and consumables. The company serves as a distributor for leading global brands and has a strong service presence in the Chinese market.

regional_presence.China: The company has a well-established presence in China, servicing numerous customers with a focus on local support and cooperation.
